data.name: Mihran
data.gender_notes: Mihran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mihran is a name that signifies kindness, justice, and peace. It is of Persian origin and is commonly used in Islamic cultures. The name Mihran carries the meaning “Kind and Just” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mihran usually hope their child will grow to embody kind and just and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Mihran is associated with the virtues of justice and compassion, which are highly valued in Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: Mihran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kind and Just.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mihran total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ميهران
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من كلمة مهر، يعني الشخص الكريم والسخي
in_arabic.long_meaning: الميهران هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة مهر التي تعني الكرم والسخاء. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرغوبة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الشخص الكريم والسخي الذي يتميز بكرمه وجوده.

in_urdu.name: مہرान
in_urdu.meaning: مہر سے متعلق، کرم اور سخاوت کا प्रतीک
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہرान ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کرم اور سخاوت۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ ایک ایسے شخص کی تصویر پیش کرتا ہے جو اپنے کرم اور سخاوت کے لئے جانا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मीहरान
in_hindi.meaning: मेह से जुड़ा, दया और उदारता का प्रतीक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मीहरान एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है दया और उदारता। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह एक ऐसे व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो अपनी दया और उदारता के लिए जाना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مهران
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهران يو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د مهربانۍ او کرم معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دود کې د يو کرمجن او سخي سړي په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Mihran
in_english.meaning: Derived from 'Mehr', meaning generous and kind
in_english.long_meaning: Mihran is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'Mehr', which means generosity and kindness. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person known for their generosity, compassion, and benevolence. The name Mihran has historical significance and is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing noble character traits.

Persia, now known as Iran, has had a profound impact on Islamic art, literature, and philosophy. The name Mihran reflects the rich Persian influence in Islamic societies and serves to honor the historical and cultural ties that exist between the two.

In many Islamic traditions, the sun represents God's divine light and is therefore a powerful symbol of God's presence and grace. The name Mihran can be seen as a reminder of the light and guidance that God provides to His creation, and is a source of encouragement and inspiration for those who bear this name. Additionally, the name Mihran is associated with the concept of generosity and kindness, reflecting the compassionate and merciful nature of God and encouraging those who bear the name to act in a kind and just manner.

historical_references.context: Mihran was a prominent figure during the reign of King Khosrow I Anushirvan (531-579 AD). He was a prince of the royal family and a skilled general. He played a significant role in the military campaigns of the Sassanid Empire against the Byzantine Empire.
